title: Fairy Realm: A Collection of the Favourite Old Tales Told in Verse
sourceTitle: Fairy Realm: A Collection of the Favourite Old Tales Told in Verse
author: Tom Hood
description: "Fairy Realm: A Collection of the Favourite Old Tales Told in Verse" by Tom Hood is a collection of beloved fairy tales presented in verse, likely written in the mid-19th century.
longDescription: This compilation features well-known stories such as "The Sleeping Beauty," "Little Red Riding Hood," "Puss in Boots," "Cinderella," and "Hop O' My Thumb," capturing the essence and charm of each tale through poetic narration.

authorInfo.bio: Tom Hood (1835–1874) wrote Fairy Realm: A Collection of the Favourite Old Tales Told in Verse. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
